question: Which of the following is NOT a non-ferrous metallic mineral?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mica.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mica** is a **non-metallic mineral**, unlike lead, bauxite, and copper, which are non-ferrous metallic minerals.
 
• Mica is commonly used as **an insulator in electrical and electronic industries due to its high thermal and electrical resistance properties.**
 
• Mica occurs in **igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks, and is mined mainly from pegmatite deposits.**
 
• India is one **of the largest producers** of mica in the world, especially in the states of **Jharkhand, Bihar, and Rajasthan.**
 
• It is not classified as a metallic mineral because it lacks the typical metallic properties like **conductivity and malleability**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-Ferrous Metallic Minerals**:

 
 
• **Lead**: A heavy metal used primarily in batteries, shielding from radiation, and in the construction industry.
 
• **Bauxite**: The primary ore of aluminum, used to produce aluminum metal for industries like aerospace, packaging, and transportation.
 
• **Copper**: A highly conductive metal used in electrical wiring, plumbing, and in the manufacture of electronics and machinery.
 
 
 
• **Non-Metallic Minerals**:
 
 
• **Mica**: A non-metallic mineral used in the production of electrical insulators, and also in cosmetics, paints, and plastics.
 
 
 
• **Ferrous vs. Non-Ferrous Metals**:
 
 
• **Ferrous metals** contain iron (e.g., steel, iron), while **non-ferrous metals** do not contain iron (e.g., aluminum, copper, lead).
 
• Non-ferrous metals are typically more resistant to corrosion and are lighter, making them ideal for industrial uses.
